verdict.rationale: The product itself is agent-oriented markdown: SKILL.md files are served as raw markdown, works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot, and includes a skill for choosing which skill to use. That makes its content directly consumable by an agent. But there is no evidence of an llms.txt or dedicated agent-facing docs index, and the probe for a markdown docs endpoint returned 404. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt, an agent-oriented docs index or markdown docs endpoint, independent corroboration.
